en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said regarding the virgin woman, her permission is her silence, and the divorced/widow, her command is in her (control)’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following:
“Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘In the case of a virgin, her remaining quiet is her permission, and a woman for her second marriage has her own command and power of decision- making.’”
